buggy_findings.mechanism: A producer-layout-dependent absolute archive digest is the admission criterion even though only same-environment base/candidate equality is stable.
buggy_findings.decisive_mutation: Build an equal base/candidate pair under an independent HOME/sysroot path and require relative byte identity without the original absolute digest.

buggy_findings.mechanism: The pinned caller delegates selected installation to an unpinned transitive callee that writes slot zero for every nonzero selection.
buggy_findings.decisive_mutation: Rebind intended source digests, mutate the callee's destination index, and exercise every selected slot with distinct values.

buggy_findings.mechanism: A complete frame postcondition has no verified consumer, so deleting it leaves verification green.
buggy_findings.decisive_mutation: Delete the entire postcondition and require a verified caller that uses each conjunct to fail.

buggy_findings.mechanism: A raw-text gate accepts the required test command when it is only a commented command.
buggy_findings.decisive_mutation: Comment out the executable command and require active-command parsing to fail.

buggy_findings.mechanism: The normative refinement and qualification document sits outside every checker input, so its safety claims can widen without invalidating evidence.
buggy_findings.decisive_mutation: Widen a normative claim and require a document contract checker or reviewed-source inventory to reject it.
